# Clear-ZbxAgentHost

## SYNOPSIS

Deletes what an agent session provisioned on the server.

## SYNTAX

```
Clear-ZbxAgentHost [-Session] <string> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Clear-ZbxAgentHost cmdlet deletes the items Initialize-ZbxAgentHost and Publish-ZbxAgentHost created for the agent session named in -Session, and the host and its interface when Initialize-ZbxAgentHost created them; a host that existed before is never deleted, only the items the session added to it. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf shows what it would delete. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Remove what an agent session provisioned

```powershell
Clear-ZbxAgentHost -Session 'web-agent' -Confirm:$false
@(Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-02*').Count
```

Initialize-ZbxAgentHost created web-02, so the host goes with its items; a search for it then finds nothing.

## PARAMETERS

### -Force

Clears without the confirmation prompt ConfirmImpact.High otherwise asks for; -WhatIf and an explicit -Confirm still apply.
